title: Changelog - January 2017
content:
## Changelog - January 2017


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093660

New Features:

- Font-Awesome Feature has been updated to version 4.7. Check the list on new Icons here .

- Security Update in the Sign Up pages.

- Clone Membership Level Functionality.

- External Developers can Add an Admin Menu Link to Custom Plugins. For further information click here .

Enhancements / Fixes:

- Bug fixes through the New Leads Module, New Reviews Module and Google Location System.

- In summary more than 15+ bugs fixed ranging from Backend, Admin Panel, Frontend and more.
